desc: Implement `Solution.minLength` with binary search over `L` from `1` to the current maximum run length.
Implement `can(L)` using DP over position, last character, and current run length `1..L`.
Ensure DP transitions correctly handle keeping the same character when run length is below `L` and switching characters with run length reset to `1`.
Add flip cost by comparing the chosen final character with the original character at each position.
Run sample tests and edge cases such as `numOps = 0`, all identical characters, already alternating strings, and small lengths, and report a SAMPLE TESTS verdict.
